response.text:
I can do that — but cancelling a calendar event is a destructive change, so I need a few details and your confirmation first.

Please confirm the following:
1. Exact event (title): "Design review"?  
2. Time of the meeting (e.g., 3:00–4:00 PM) and time zone.  
3. Scope: cancel only the next Tuesday occurrence, all future occurrences, or the entire series (including past entries can't be removed but future ones will be cancelled).  
4. Notify attendees? (yes / no). If yes, do you want to include a short message/reason to attendees? If so, provide the text or say “I’ll write one.”  
5. Any other actions — e.g., propose a new time, remove conferencing link, or keep the event on your calendar privately?

Reply with those details (or just “Yes, cancel the entire series and notify attendees with this message: …”) and I’ll proceed.
